verdict.rationale: Caveman is an open-source skill for AI coding agents, so a skill-authoring meta-skill is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows a skill or tool that guides an agent through writing, improving or packaging new skills. The docs cover response compression, a CLI wrapper, plugins, automations and graded tests of requests, none of which is skill authoring.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection ships a meta-skill or tool that guides my agent through writing, improving, and packaging new skills
